weather_report:
As the sun glimmers cautiously behind a veil of clouds, Boston bears witness to a distinctly warm afternoon, the air gently stirring with a southern breeze. The temperature nudges comfortably close to a balmy 85 degrees, inviting an array of activities that spill from vibrant parks to the hidden corners of cozy cafés. On this evening, however, an intricate dance of weather unfolds, as the forecast hints at a turbulent night ahead. Chances of rain showers begin to creep in as twilight descends, with the specter of thunderstorms drawing nearer. As darkness settles, a thickening fog will cloak the city, the clouds gathering to unleash not just rain but perhaps the rumbling symphony of distant thunder.

For those who venture out, a light jacket may be prudent—something breathable yet sturdy; the air will turn warm and heavy as night deepens, perhaps even cooler with the onset of rain. A stroll along the waterfront might charm those seeking solace amid the impending storm, but it may be wise to keep an eye on the ever-changing sky. The taste of rain in the air might also lure one into the welcoming arms of a favorite bookstore or a quiet corner of a nearby wine bar, where the soft glow of interior lights contrasts the murkiness outside. It’s a day where the promise of sunlight gives way to the whispers of unsettled weather, each moment urging a mindful engagement with both the beauty and unpredictability that summer in Boston so often gifts us.
